Our mission

Our mission is to bring people together and support local pubs by encouraging everyone to meet with people they love, socialise, and have new experiences.

It’s not really about the pints, and everybody is welcome, whether you grab some food, have something non-alcoholic, or enjoy a drink. Please do be careful with drinking. What matters most is that you have fun with the people you love, not what you drink.

So come along, bring your friends, grab some food, have a drink if you fancy one, and enjoy yourself. And if you want to keep an eye on your drinking, download the MyDrinkaware app.
